This plot is small and I am growing beans with other crops mixed in, so the beans themselves help the soil. I do not want to spend money on chemical fertilizer for legumes when my cash is tight — but I will carry manure from my animals to the plot before planting. The insects eat cowpea badly every year, so I must spray at least once or twice or I will lose the harvest. I will use my own seed kept from last year, and my family will do most of the work, though I may call a few hands for weeding since I am getting older.
